home.marquee_text: Architecture · Interior Design · 3D Visualization · BIM · Revit · SketchUp · Lumion · Unreal Engine · 13+ Years ·

about.hero_title:
Designing with purpose.
Building with integrity.
about.bio_1: I am Niloufar Zanjani, architect and interior designer with over 13 years of professional experience across residential and commercial projects. My approach bridges modern art and engineering precision — creating spaces that are as functional as they are beautiful.
about.bio_2: After a decade of design, construction supervision and project management, and three years of freelance practice, I founded NILZ Architecture & Interior Design Group in Al Mouj, Muscat — and hold membership in the Oman Society of Engineers.
about.bio_3: I believe quality of life is rooted in the spaces we inhabit. I am committed to turning vision into enduring reality — through authentic materials, meticulous detail, and the latest in architectural knowledge.

values.title: Contextual Design
values.body: I design with the surroundings in mind — creating spaces that feel rooted in place, culture, and natural light.

values.title: Timeless Aesthetics
values.body: Every detail is carefully considered to ensure longevity, elegance, and a visual language that transcends trends.

values.title: Functional Flow
values.body: From layout to circulation, I prioritise clarity and ease of use — shaping environments that support daily life intuitively.

values.title: Collaborative Process
values.body: I work closely with clients, engineers, and builders — ensuring every decision is aligned with the shared vision.

services.hero_title: Architecture shaped by vision and detail.
services.intro: I deliver thoughtful architectural solutions that solve complex challenges with clarity, creativity, and precision.

items.title: Vision & Scope
items.body: Every project begins with dialogue. I listen, define the brief, and understand your vision — setting the direction for everything that follows.

items.title: Planning
items.body: I study the location, light, landscape, and context to shape a concept that feels grounded and natural — both functionally and emotionally.

items.title: Designing
items.body: From massing to materials, I craft bold yet timeless spaces that balance aesthetics, purpose, and lived experience.

items.title: Documentation
items.body: I prepare precise drawings and documentation — collaborating with engineers and consultants to ensure feasibility, performance, and a flawless build.
